title: DR1 shows the animals and packages totals from the moment a notification is created; the frontend hides the whole summary, heading and all, until a commodity has been added.

finding.frontend: A user who has answered where the consignment comes from and not yet chosen a commodity opens the hub on the heading 'Overview' and then goes straight into '1. About the consignment'. There is no 'Your commodities' heading and no totals above it — the picture is fe-hub-no-commodity, and the string does not occur in that page at all. The heading and the two totals cards are wrapped in a condition on there being at least one commodity line (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/template.njk:8-26), and the totals are built as null when there are none (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:142-151). Add a commodity and the block appears: the same user, one answer later, meets a page with a new section at the top of it, and the cards read 0 and 0 until a number of animals is given.
finding.prototype: DR1 renders the summary section unconditionally and shows '0' in each card until there is something to count (app/views/notification-hub.html:26-50). The captured DR1 hub is of a notification where nothing has been answered at all and it still shows 'Your commodities' with 0 animals and 0 packages/boxes. The shape of the page does not change as the notification is filled in.
finding.difference: Render the commodity summary on every hub, showing zero in both cards when there is nothing to count, so the page keeps the same shape from the first visit to the last. One condition removed from the template and a zero default where the totals are built.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub on a notification with no commodity added that still shows the 'Your commodities' heading and its two cards.
finding.correction: The state the falsifier asks for was captured after this finding was written, and it confirms rather than falsifies. fe-hub-no-commodity is a hub with country of origin answered and no commodity chosen: it holds no 'Your commodities' heading, no `app-commodity-total` card and no occurrence of the string anywhere in the rendered page, where fe-hub — the same journey one answer further on — holds the heading and both cards reading 0. Both frontend states are now photographed against DR1's single unchanging one, so the claim is observed rather than read, and confidence is raised from medium to high. Two details the pictures add. The frontend's zero is reached from the other direction than DR1's: DR1 shows 0 because nothing has been counted, the frontend shows 0 only once a line exists but its number of animals is blank, so the two pages agree on the number and disagree on when the number is worth showing. And the block's arrival moves everything below it down the page, so the task list a user is working through does not sit still — which is the argument for this change beyond consistency with DR1.
